CURRENT SCENE:
所以，他上山下山找植物，吃了很多样子的植物。他是第一人，找到了茶。他把所有的植物写下来了。他一直都吃了，他连毒都能吃。可是他还没吃了一个叫夹竹桃的植物。他找到了那个像星星的植物，觉得很漂亮，马上就吃下了。

ITEMS:

[I329] 吃了很多【样子】的植物   correction: 样子 → 种   strength: error
  checker's note: plants are counted with 种, not 样子
  rule card (modifier_de_structure, Grammar): Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <modifier> describes the noun <noun>, so use 的; or <modifier> does not need 的 here, so omit it.  Her terms: no的
  her past correction: 吃很多[-的]植物
  her past correction: [植物一看→一看到植物]就吃了 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: [植物→一种绿色的植物]他觉得好吃得很

[I330] 他是第【一】人   correction: 一 → 一个   strength: error
  checker's note: 第一人 needs the measure word 个
  rule card (measure_word_choice, Grammar): Use the appropriate measure word before the noun: 这/那 + Measure word + noun. Use noun-specific measure words such as 棵 for trees, and 位 is a polite MW.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <measure word> with <noun>; <brief reason, such as “位” is polite or 棵 is for trees>.  Her terms: 这/那 + Measure word + noun, 本+N., 位, MW
  her past correction: 有[一位人→一个人]来了
  her past correction: [起头→一开始]
  her past correction: 他又[+一次]爬上去梯子的时候

[I331] 他是第一【人，】找到了茶   correction: 人， → 个   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]喝了茶 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 他[找了→找到了]第一个菜 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他找了第一个[菜→植物]

[I332] 找到【了】茶   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [-他]喝了茶 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 神农尝[+了]花儿以后就发现这个花儿不但可以被用做茶 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 他[找了→找到了]第一个菜 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find

[I333] 找到了茶【^】   correction: ∅ → 的人   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]喝了茶 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 神农尝[+了]花儿以后就发现这个花儿不但可以被用做茶 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 难怪他成为很聪明[+的人]

[I334] 他把所有的植物【^】写下来了   correction: ∅ → 的名字   strength: error
  checker's note: one writes down the plants' names
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他尝[+了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-他]写下了哪些植物有毒 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 学习植物[+的知识]

[I335] 他一直都【^】吃了   correction: ∅ → 在   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 毒他吃[+了]很多次 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 可是他[+什么都]没有吃了
  her past correction: [+有]毒他吃很多次

[I336] 他一直都吃【了】   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 一直 describing an ongoing habit does not take 了
  rule card (no_le_with_mei, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了 (no了in “没+V.”).  Her terms: 没+ V., no了in “没+V.”, verb is an action verb
  her past correction: 可是他没有吃[-了] — her note: no了in “没+V.”
  her past correction: [-他]吃了以后 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 毒他吃[+了]很多次 — her note: 了completed

[I337] 【他】连毒都能吃   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [+有]毒他吃很多次
  her past correction: [-他]吃了以后 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 毒他吃[+了]很多次 — her note: 了completed

[I338] 可是他还没吃【了】一个叫夹竹桃的植物   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 没 + V., no 了
  rule card (no_le_with_mei, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了 (no了in “没+V.”).  Her terms: 没+ V., no了in “没+V.”, verb is an action verb
  her past correction: 可是他没有吃[-了] — her note: no了in “没+V.”
  her past correction: 可是[-吃]夹竹桃有毒
  her past correction: 但是吃[+了]像伞一样的植物以后 — her note: 了completed

[I339] 可是他还没吃了一【个】叫夹竹桃的植物   correction: 个 → 种   strength: error
  checker's note: plants are normally counted with 种
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 可是[-吃]夹竹桃有毒
  her past correction: 另外一个植物[-是]叫夹竹桃
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]一个夹竹桃 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: Use 种 for types of plants. 样子 means an appearance or shape, not a plant type.
Use 个 with 人: 第一个人. 个 is the usual MW for a person here.
It would be more natural to say 第一个找到茶的人. This makes 找到茶 clearly describe the person.
It would be more natural to omit 了 in 第一个找到茶的人. Here 找到茶 describes the person, rather than simply reporting a completed action.
Add 的人 after 找到茶 to show that this action describes the person: 第一个找到茶的人.
Write down the plants’ names, not the plants themselves. Use 植物的名字 here.
It would be more natural to use 在 for an ongoing action: 一直都在吃. 在 shows the action is durative.
一直 describes an ongoing habit, not a completed action, so omit 了. Use 一直都在吃 or 一直都吃.
他 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it. Chinese uses zero form here to avoid too many 他.
This action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了: 还没吃. This is no了in “没+V.”.
Use 种 for a type of plant: 一种叫夹竹桃的植物. 个 is not the usual MW when introducing a plant type.
